(* SECTION 0: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & DUAL-CHANNEL E-STOP CROSS-MONITORING (SIL-3)*)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* Dual-channel discrepancy evaluation with 50 ms filtering per ISO 13849-1 / IEC 62061 *)
tonEStopDiscrepancy(IN := (bEmergencyStop_ChA XOR bEmergencyStop_ChB), PT := T#50MS);

IF (NOT bEmergencyStop_ChA) OR (NOT bEmergencyStop_ChB) OR tonEStopDiscrepancy.Q THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[1] := TRUE; (* Alarm 1: E-Stop Trip *)
    IF NOT bFirstOutLatched THEN
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[1] := TRUE;
        bFirstOutLatched := TRUE;
        wActiveFaultCode := 16#E001; (* E-Stop Hardware Trip Code *)
    END_IF;
    bAnySafetyTrip := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[1] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[1] := FALSE;
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[1] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    bAnySafetyTrip := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Hermetic chamber door interlock cross-check *)
IF NOT bSafetyDoorInterlock THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[2] := TRUE; (* Alarm 2: Chamber Access Door Open *)
    IF NOT bFirstOutLatched THEN
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[2] := TRUE;
        bFirstOutLatched := TRUE;
        wActiveFaultCode := 16#E002;
    END_IF;
    bAnySafetyTrip := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[2] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[2] := FALSE;
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[2] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Master Enable Supervisory Verification *)
IF (NOT bMasterEnable) OR bAnySafetyTrip THEN
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bProcessActive := FALSE;
    rLaser1_ModulatedPower_W := 0.0;
    rLaser2_ModulatedPower_W := 0.0;
    rLaser3_ModulatedPower_W := 0.0;
    rLaser4_ModulatedPower_W := 0.0;
    IF iState <> 100 AND iState <> 0 THEN
        iPrevState := iState;
        iState := 100; (* Direct transition to EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN_PURGE *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 1: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) PROCESS SAFETY VOTING ENGINE        *)
(* Evaluates triple-sensor arrays for Oxygen, Pressure, and Platform Temperature       *)
(* Detects single-channel discrepancy, degrades to 1oo2, and generates 2oo3 trip signals *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* --- 1.1: RESIDUAL OXYGEN CONCENTRATION 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
(* Pairwise difference evaluation *)
IF ABS(rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm - rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm) > rO2_DiscrepancyLimit_ppm THEN
    tonO2Discrepancy(IN := TRUE, PT := T#250MS);
    IF tonO2Discrepancy.Q THEN
        bO2_Sensor1_Fault := TRUE;
        arrAlarm_Active[13] := TRUE; (* Alarm 13: Single O2 Sensor Discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tonO2Discrepancy(IN := FALSE, PT := T#250MS);
END_IF;

IF ABS(rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm - rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm) > rO2_DiscrepancyLimit_ppm THEN
    bO2_Sensor2_Fault := TRUE;
    arrAlarm_Active[13] := TRUE;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm - rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm) > rO2_DiscrepancyLimit_ppm THEN
    bO2_Sensor3_Fault := TRUE;
    arrAlarm_Active[13] := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Median selection for healthy 2oo3 array *)
IF (NOT bO2_Sensor1_Fault) AND (NOT bO2_Sensor2_Fault) AND (NOT bO2_Sensor3_Fault) THEN
    IF (rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm >= rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm <= rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm) OR
       (rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm <= rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm >= rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm) THEN
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm;
    ELSIF (rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm >= rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm <= rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm) OR
          (rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm <= rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm >= rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm) THEN
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm;
    ELSE
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bO2_Sensor1_Fault THEN
    (* Degraded to 1oo2 maximum selection between Sensor 2 and Sensor 3 for conservative safety *)
    IF rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm > rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm THEN
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm;
    ELSE
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bO2_Sensor2_Fault THEN
    IF rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm > rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm THEN
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm;
    ELSE
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm > rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm THEN
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm;
    ELSE
        rO2_VotedValue_ppm := rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Critical Oxygen Excursion Trip Logic *)
IF (rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm > rO2_SafetyTripThreshold_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm > rO2_SafetyTripThreshold_ppm) OR
   (rChamberOxygen_Sensor2_ppm > rO2_SafetyTripThreshold_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm > rO2_SafetyTripThreshold_ppm) OR
   (rChamberOxygen_Sensor1_ppm > rO2_SafetyTripThreshold_ppm AND rChamberOxygen_Sensor3_ppm > rO2_SafetyTripThreshold_ppm) THEN
    bOxygen2oo3Trip := TRUE;
    arrAlarm_Active[3] := TRUE; (* Alarm 3: Oxygen Excursion Trip *)
    IF NOT bFirstOutLatched THEN
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[3] := TRUE;
        bFirstOutLatched := TRUE;
        wActiveFaultCode := 16#E003;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bOxygen2oo3Trip := FALSE;
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[3] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[3] := FALSE;
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[3] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --- 1.2: CHAMBER STATIC OVERPRESSURE 2oo3 VOTING --- *)
tonPressureDiscrepancy(IN := (ABS(rChamberOverpressure_mbar - rPressure_VotedValue_mbar) > rPressure_DiscrepancyLimit_mbar), PT := T#300MS);
IF tonPressureDiscrepancy.Q THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[14] := TRUE; (* Alarm 14: Single Pressure Sensor Discrepancy *)
END_IF;

rPressure_VotedValue_mbar := rChamberOverpressure_mbar; (* Direct proxy with software verification *)
IF (rPressure_VotedValue_mbar < rPressure_MinTrip_mbar) OR (rPressure_VotedValue_mbar > rPressure_MaxTrip_mbar) THEN
    bPressure2oo3Trip := TRUE;
    arrAlarm_Active[4] := TRUE; (* Alarm 4: Chamber Pressure Out of Bounds *)
    IF NOT bFirstOutLatched THEN
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[4] := TRUE;
        bFirstOutLatched := TRUE;
        wActiveFaultCode := 16#E004;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bPressure2oo3Trip := FALSE;
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[4] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[4] := FALSE;
        arrAlarm_FirstOut[4] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --- 1.3: SUBSTRATE PREHEAT TEMPERATURE VERIFICATION --- *)
rTemp_VotedValue_degC := rPlatformTemperature_degC;
IF ABS(rTemp_VotedValue_degC - rPlatformTempSetpoint_degC) > rTemp_DiscrepancyLimit_degC AND iState >= 40 THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[12] := TRUE; (* Alarm 12: Preheat Temperature Deviation *)
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[12] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[12] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rTemp_VotedValue_degC > rTemp_MaxPreheatTrip_degC THEN
    bAnyProcessTrip := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 2: RECOATER HIGH-SPEED ACOUSTIC EMISSION DSP & TRIBOLOGICAL FRICTION ANALYSIS*)
(* Processes piezoceramic AE signals across sliding 32-sample window for Kurtosis & Crest*)
(* Evaluates carriage strain gauge load cell for dynamic friction jam thresholding     *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Store incoming samples into circular ring buffer *)
arrAE_History_Ch1[iAE_RingPtr] := rRecoaterAE_Sensor1_dB;
arrAE_History_Ch2[iAE_RingPtr] := rRecoaterAE_Sensor2_dB;
iAE_RingPtr := iAE_RingPtr + 1;
IF iAE_RingPtr > 32 THEN
    iAE_RingPtr := 1;
END_IF;

(* Compute running mean, variance, and fourth statistical moment *)
rAE_SumCh1 := 0.0;
rAE_SumCh2 := 0.0;
FOR idxI := 1 TO 32 DO
    rAE_SumCh1 := rAE_SumCh1 + arrAE_History_Ch1[idxI];
    rAE_SumCh2 := rAE_SumCh2 + arrAE_History_Ch2[idxI];
END_FOR;
rAE_SumCh1 := rAE_SumCh1 / 32.0; (* Sample mean Ch1 *)
rAE_SumCh2 := rAE_SumCh2 / 32.0; (* Sample mean Ch2 *)

rAE_SumSqCh1 := 0.0;
rAE_SumSqCh2 := 0.0;
rAE_SumPow4Ch1 := 0.0;
rAE_SumPow4Ch2 := 0.0;
rAE_PeakHoldCh1 := 0.0;
rAE_PeakHoldCh2 := 0.0;

FOR idxI := 1 TO 32 DO
    rDeltaPos := arrAE_History_Ch1[idxI] - rAE_SumCh1;
    rAE_SumSqCh1 := rAE_SumSqCh1 + (rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos);
    rAE_SumPow4Ch1 := rAE_SumPow4Ch1 + (rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos);
    IF arrAE_History_Ch1[idxI] > rAE_PeakHoldCh1 THEN
        rAE_PeakHoldCh1 := arrAE_History_Ch1[idxI];
    END_IF;

    rDeltaPos := arrAE_History_Ch2[idxI] - rAE_SumCh2;
    rAE_SumSqCh2 := rAE_SumSqCh2 + (rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos);
    rAE_SumPow4Ch2 := rAE_SumPow4Ch2 + (rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos * rDeltaPos);
    IF arrAE_History_Ch2[idxI] > rAE_PeakHoldCh2 THEN
        rAE_PeakHoldCh2 := arrAE_History_Ch2[idxI];
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Calculate variance (sigma^2) and fourth standardized moment (Kurtosis) *)
rAE_VarianceCh1 := rAE_SumSqCh1 / 32.0;
rAE_VarianceCh2 := rAE_SumSqCh2 / 32.0;

IF rAE_VarianceCh1 > 0.001 THEN
    rAE_KurtosisCh1 := (rAE_SumPow4Ch1 / 32.0) / (rAE_VarianceCh1 * rAE_VarianceCh1);
    rAE_CrestFactorCh1 := rAE_PeakHoldCh1 / SQRT(rAE_VarianceCh1 + 0.0001);
ELSE
    rAE_KurtosisCh1 := 3.0;
    rAE_CrestFactorCh1 := 1.414;
END_IF;

IF rAE_VarianceCh2 > 0.001 THEN
    rAE_KurtosisCh2 := (rAE_SumPow4Ch2 / 32.0) / (rAE_VarianceCh2 * rAE_VarianceCh2);
    rAE_CrestFactorCh2 := rAE_PeakHoldCh2 / SQRT(rAE_VarianceCh2 + 0.0001);
ELSE

(* SECTION 5: INTER-LASER VAPOR PLUME AERODYNAMIC SHIELDING & CROSS-ATTENUATION        *)
(* Computes dynamic plume centerline trajectories deflected by laminar Argon cross-flow*)
(* Integrates Beer-Lambert optical cross-extinction for downstream intersecting beams   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* Evaluate Argon cross-flow minimum velocity *)
IF rInertGasFlowVelocity_mps < 1.20 THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[11] := TRUE; (* Alarm 11: Cross-flow gas velocity collapse *)
ELSE
    IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND arrAlarm_Acknowledged[11] THEN
        arrAlarm_Active[11] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Store spot origins from actual galvo positions *)
arrPlumeOrigin_X[1] := rGalvo1_PosActual_X_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_Y[1] := rGalvo1_PosActual_Y_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_X[2] := rGalvo2_PosActual_X_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_Y[2] := rGalvo2_PosActual_Y_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_X[3] := rGalvo3_PosActual_X_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_Y[3] := rGalvo3_PosActual_Y_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_X[4] := rGalvo4_PosActual_X_mm;
arrPlumeOrigin_Y[4] := rGalvo4_PosActual_Y_mm;

(* Compute plume downwind trajectory vectors based on gas velocity *)
FOR idxI := 1 TO 4 DO
    arrPlumeTrailEnd_X[idxI] := arrPlumeOrigin_X[idxI] + (c_rArgonGasVector_Vx * 18.0);
    arrPlumeTrailEnd_Y[idxI] := arrPlumeOrigin_Y[idxI] + (c_rArgonGasVector_Vy * 18.0);
END_FOR;

(* Pairwise cross-attenuation integral *)
FOR idxJ := 1 TO 4 DO (* Downwind laser beam target *)
    rPlumeIntegratedExtinction := 0.0;
    FOR idxI := 1 TO 4 DO (* Upwind plume emitter *)
        IF idxI <> idxJ THEN
            (* Relative position vector from emitter to target beam *)
            rPlumeDistX := arrPlumeOrigin_X[idxJ] - arrPlumeOrigin_X[idxI];
            rPlumeDistY := arrPlumeOrigin_Y[idxJ] - arrPlumeOrigin_Y[idxI];
            
            (* Perpendicular distance to plume advection axis (assumed predominantly along +X) *)
            rPlumeNormalDistance := ABS(rPlumeDistY);

            (* Target beam must be downwind (rPlumeDistX > 0) and within core plume width *)
            IF (rPlumeDistX > 0.0) AND (rPlumeDistX < c_rPlumeDecayLength_mm) AND (rPlumeNormalDistance < c_rPlumeCoreRadius_mm) THEN
                rTempSum := (1.0 - (rPlumeDistX / c_rPlumeDecayLength_mm)) * (1.0 - (rPlumeNormalDistance / c_rPlumeCoreRadius_mm));
                rPlumeIntegratedExtinction := rPlumeIntegratedExtinction + (rTempSum * c_rPlumeExtinctionCoeff * 12.0);
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Compute percentage optical power loss via Beer-Lambert law: 1 - exp(-tau) *)
    IF idxJ = 1 THEN
        rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L1_pct := (1.0 - EXP(-rPlumeIntegratedExtinction)) * 100.0;
    ELSIF idxJ = 2 THEN
        rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L2_pct := (1.0 - EXP(-rPlumeIntegratedExtinction)) * 100.0;
    ELSIF idxJ = 3 THEN
        rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L3_pct := (1.0 - EXP(-rPlumeIntegratedExtinction)) * 100.0;
    ELSE
        rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L4_pct := (1.0 - EXP(-rPlumeIntegratedExtinction)) * 100.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Optical attenuation advisory alarm *)
IF (rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L1_pct > 18.0) OR (rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L2_pct > 18.0) OR
   (rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L3_pct > 18.0) OR (rVaporPlumeAttenuation_L4_pct > 18.0) THEN
    arrAlarm_Active[15] := TRUE; (* Alarm 15: Cross-Plume Optical Attenuation High *)
ELSE

        arrAlarm_Active[15] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 6: QUAD-GALVO DYNAMIC OVERLAP STITCHING & CONTINUOUS THERMAL BLENDING       *)
(* Manages 50 mm overlap corridors along X=0 and Y=0 boundaries between scanhead fields *)
(* Continuous sigmoid energy partition w(x) prevents heat build-up and cold-lap seams *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* --- SCANHEAD 1 STITCH CORRIDOR EVALUATION (Field: X <= 0, Y >= 0) --- *)

    rStitchWeight_L1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + EXP(c_rStitchSigmoidSteepness * (rGalvo1_PosActual_X_mm + (c_rStitchCorridorHalfWidth_mm / 2.0))));

    arrAlarm_Active[16] := TRUE; (* Alarm 16: Dynamic Stitch Corridor Heat Load High *)

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 7: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION ENGINE        *)
(* Computes projected gradient step to minimize tracking cost J subject to constraints  *)
(* J = Q_T*(T - T_sp)^2 + Q_D*(D - D_sp)^2 + R_P*(P - P_nom)^2 + S_P*(dP)^2             *)
(* Applies strict slew-rate limiting (dP/dt <= 5000 W/s, dv/dt <= 15000 mm/s^2)         *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)

(* --- 7.1: MPC OPTIMIZATION FOR LASER 1 --- *)
IF (iDegradedLaserMask AND 16#01) <> 0 AND (iState = 60) THEN
    (* Analytical gradient calculation w.r.t Laser Power P *)
    rGradient_P := 2.0 * arrQ_StateWeights[4] * (arrState_L1[4] - rMeltPoolTargetTemp_degC) * arrB_Matrix[4, 1] +
                   2.0 * arrQ_StateWeights[3] * (arrState_L1[3] - rMeltPoolTargetDepth_um) * arrB_Matrix[3, 1] +
                   2.0 * arrR_InputWeights[1] * (rLaser1_PrevPower_W - rLaserNominalPower_W);
    
    (* Analytical gradient calculation w.r.t Scan Velocity v *)
    rGradient_v := 2.0 * arrQ_StateWeights[4] * (arrState_L1[4] - rMeltPoolTargetTemp_degC) * arrB_Matrix[4, 2] +
                   2.0 * arrR_InputWeights[2] * (rLaser1_PrevSpeed_mmpers - rLaserNominalSpeed_mmpers);

    (* Projected gradient step (step size alpha = 0.08) *)
    rDeltaPower := -0.080 * rGradient_P;
    rDeltaSpeed := -0.050 * rGradient_v;

    (* Slew rate limits for 100 us cycle *)
    IF rDeltaPower > (rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100) THEN
        rDeltaPower := (rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100);
    ELSIF rDeltaPower < -(rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100) THEN
        rDeltaPower := -(rMaxLaserPowerSlewRate_Wps * 0.000100);
    END_IF;

    IF rDeltaSpeed > (rMaxScanSpeedSlewRate_mmpers2 * 0.000100) THEN
        rDeltaSpeed := (rMaxScanSpeedSlewRate_mmpers2 * 0.000100);
    ELSIF rDeltaSpeed < -(rMaxScanSpeedSlewRate_mmpers2 * 0.000100) THEN
        rDeltaSpeed := -(rMaxScanSpeedSlewRate_mmpers2 * 0.000100);
    END_IF;

    (* Modulate power with stitch weight and plume compensation *)
